'''Dylan Bensel DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Dylan Bensel]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-13348">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13348 DeckTech post 13348], DeckTech (Dylan "CannedMunki" Bensel, 2 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13348/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13348/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018055821/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13348/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''vader's beyotches'''
* '''Author:''' Dylan "CannedMunki" Bensel
* '''Published:''' February 2, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 1.5
* '''Description:''' kik their A$$

=== Strategy ===

The main idea of this deck is to use Twelik advisor to deploy well guarded so they don't beep you over and make you lose your 35 storm troopers.

Deploy a Vader and a comlink on him.  Then you can react by deploying a crap load of storm troopers.

Use Expand the empire to make your force drains plus one at your locations.

Use trooper assault and get alot o power and woop em.

Use The empires back to get out vader
